candidates.A0: Exact frozen candidate-v1 and V3 replay: 20-high breakout, RS>=0, turnover>=1000, ATR20 volatility weight capped .25, basic 5% entry-price stop, original trend exit, P5D calendar deadline
candidates.A1: Only replace P5D with 5 completed eligible observed sessions since actual first entry. Exit at the next modeled opening. Other A0 rules unchanged
candidates.A2: Replace P5D with prior close below mean of preceding 20 closes, retaining A0 entry/weight/basic stop and original trend exit; hard maximum 20 completed eligible observed sessions
candidates.A3: A2 plus trailing exit when prior close <= max(entry cost, completed holding closes) - 3 * ATR20; ATR20 arithmetic mean of last 20 true ranges using 21 completed bars, refreshed before decision; maximum 20 eligible observed sessions

eligible_session: Completed stock/index-aligned observed date with positive stock volume and turnover, excluding inherited SPECIAL_NO_EXECUTION dates. Count entry-date close as session 1. This is not a certified KRX calendar
entry_controls: T0/T1/T2/T3 pair with A0/A1/A2/A3 respectively. Replace flat-entry 20-high breakout with prior close >= preceding 20-close mean. Retain same RS, turnover, volatility sizing, .25 cap, no averaging, costs and each paired exit rule
execution: Frozen V3: previous-close +/-5% limits, prior-volume .001 capacity proxy, adverse rounded slippage at assumed next observed open+1s, 1-minute expiration, 1-share floor, no automatic favorable residual fill, no T/T+1 sale-proceeds reuse, no forced terminal liquidation. No quote/trade/halt evidence
exposure_controls: Report actual mean/max stock exposure, holding days, daily NAV volatility, stock/index return beta and worst close day. POSTHOC_DIAGNOSTIC only: scale each pair's cash-excess PnL by common=min(pair mean exposures)/own mean exposure; no implementation or allocation feedback, zero exposures => NULL. No claim of equal full risk

candidate_failure_criteria.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Missing/invalid common panel, accounting or preservation failure
candidate_failure_criteria.RESEARCH_CANDIDATE_REJECT: A1-A3 improve A0 net in at most 1/6 stocks in BASE and at most 1/6 in STRESS
candidate_failure_criteria.RESEARCH_CANDIDATE_RETAIN: Improve A0 net in >=4/6 stocks in both BASE and STRESS; MDD <= A0 MDD + .02 in >=5/6 BASE stocks; beat paired trend-entry control in >=4/6 BASE stocks; positive A0 improvements in >=2 of the four non-semiconductor-sample stocks
candidate_failure_criteria.RESEARCH_CANDIDATE_REVISE: Valid results not meeting RETAIN or REJECT; A0 remains frozen reference, not a replacement decision

safety: Residual holdings with target zero and failed modeled reduction are RISK_REDUCTION_HOLD irrespective of research ranking. Unknown/halted market cannot be assumed executable. No PARTIAL_EXECUTION_MODEL_V2 or probabilistic calibration introduced
